issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 08 uses SELECT * and therefore returns all columns from Gemeinde, but the problem statement explicitly requires only Name, Landkreis, Fläche and the Einwohnerzahlen. This mismatch means the reference solution does not adhere to the stated output requirements and can confuse students about which columns they must return (and may cause automated checks to fail if they expect exact columns).
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution query to select only the requested columns, e.g. SELECT name, kreis, flaeche, einwohner_m, einwohner_w FROM Gemeinde WHERE (einwohner_m > 50000 AND einwohner_w > 50000) OR flaeche > 100. This ensures the reference solution matches the problem's requirement to return exactly the specified columns.
